verdict.rationale: Morph is a hosted API service, so a data-export story is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no way to export account data, such as stored Reflex training sets, trained classifiers, usage logs or chat history, in open formats. OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints and the migration guides lower switching cost, but that is adjacent portability, not a data-export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
